preregistered.rule: preregistration.json arms × frozen suite-manifest cases × planned repetitions — the authorization subset never shrinks this denominator

authorized.note: authorized SUBSET of the preregistered plan (may cover only part of the denominator)

scope.lostToFollowUpRule: RESULT_UNKNOWN settlements and reserved-but-unsettled units — retained in the denominator, excluded from valid pairs (SPEC §9.3/§9.5), never auto-counted as behavioral failure

behavioralBenefit.scope: preregistered applicable-positive cases (principleApplicable=true) with a valid A/B pair
behavioralBenefit.note: descriptive paired counts only — no causal claim (SPEC §1.2/§9.4)

boundaryNegativeTransfer.scope: boundary cases (principleApplicable=false ∧ studyEligible=true, SPEC §5.2/§9.1) — retained, never dropped

semanticSources.boundaryRisk: forbiddenBehaviorOccurred on boundary cases — reported separately, NOT merged into negativeTransfer

independentDecisionVariables.reason: the frozen suite carries no decision-variable metadata bound per case — counting from hashes would be inference, not evidence (SPEC §9.4 覆盖)

transferEstimability.reason: requires ≥2 verifiably distinct decision contexts; no such metadata is frozen with the suite (SPEC §5.1)

analysisRules.primaryAttempt: per-attempt state from the ledger's classifyUnit (last ATTEMPT_RESULT wins per attemptId); unit current state prefers succeeded > failed_known > result_unknown — provenance: challenge-ledger.mjs, the existing recovery authority
analysisRules.ambiguousPrimary: multiple SUCCEEDED attempts with diverging adjudication → AMBIGUOUS, excluded from the paired main analysis, kept in sensitivity
analysisRules.negativeTransfer: adjudication.negativeTransfer verbatim — never redefined at the report layer
analysisRules.boundaryRisk: forbiddenBehaviorOccurred on boundary cases — a separate indicator, never merged into negativeTransfer

sensitivity.note: units recovered via a NEW attemptId after RESULT_UNKNOWN, and units whose multiple SUCCEEDED attempts diverge — full records retained above

limitations: descriptive aggregation of raw evidence only — no causal inference (SPEC §1.2)
unknown/failed settlements are honest outcomes, not corruption; coverage is limited by what actually settled
monetary cost unobservable without a bound per-token price; tokens are reported raw
